title: F-16 Full Mission Flight Training Device (FTD)
summary: High-fidelity supersonic fighter simulator replicating flight handling qualities, tactical cockpit avionics, and mission systems.
highlights: Real-time cockpit avionics, Heads-Up Display (HUD), and multi-function display simulation.
Hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) interface bridging physical cockpit instruments, stick, and throttle controls.
Multi-channel curved visual projection alignment and mission scenario injection.
